list: the official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation Network (names, descriptions and grades cross-checked on Exophase and PSNProfiles, November 2026); guides written in our own words, facts cited to PowerPyx and GTABase

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no shortcut: finish the story, work through the 100% checklist and clean up the rest, in the order of the roadmap above. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours in a single playthrough, with no online trophies and no DLC needed.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first story mission, so this unlocks naturally as you start the game and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it pops when the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins — just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. PowerPyx notes it pops as Chapter 3 opens with its first mission, Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. PowerPyx places the pop at the end of the final Chapter 4 main mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. PowerPyx lists it as an automatic story trophy at the end of the story (the Chapter 4 finale, Starting From Zero); there is nothing extra to do — just reach the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Automatic and unmissable — just play the mission when it appears.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 optional missions and 15 of 18 meditations are enough. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories freely; flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which you have done; most unlock naturally while working on the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx links a full location guide for every range; the gold medals here are not too hard, and ranges also level up your Focus, which helps Gunslinger later.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). Winning one race at each location is enough; PowerPyx has a location guide for all 14.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations; wins at different spots count, repeats do not, so work through the map rather than replaying one favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him at it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are 4 video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels of any one game; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is Lucia-only and gets marked in Chapter 3 (Belville). Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. He is marked in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams (green KR icon, Key Lento). Dive for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — he marks purple chest icons on the map, and a metal detector digs the treasure from the ocean floor. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count — PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. All strangers are still there after the story; track your count in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS you get the Key Cloner and deliver the Zorrusso to Randy; he then hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to him (green RK icon, west Vice City). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the list, and deliver them in good condition for more pay.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, Jason-only, marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs in Vice City (Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone gives you the second quest, Spin On This. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double, and you can track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONE TO WATCH: PowerPyx flags this as the only potentially missable trophy. During Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning, walks out to the balcony at Jason's house, and you must follow her and accept. That balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — do it to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts Jason (Jason-only) and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His questline sends you to hunting spots marked with purple icons; bring the animals back to him. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle on the first quest. PowerPyx notes the exact animal that pops the trophy is still being confirmed, and the 15 Target Decks are needed for the 100% checklist anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx links all 18 set locations; you only need 3 sets, so pick the easiest ones to reach and ignore the rest.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) to scan 100 locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. Any 100 count, and scanning also feeds the vehicle and discovery goals, so keep the app out while you explore.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest ones left; most complete naturally while working on other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). Cause chaos to 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone — PowerPyx recommends a fast sports bike, or the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the helicopter cannot follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission That's Where The Money Is…

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.target: 3 shops in a row, wanted level kept
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level) across all 3 robberies. PowerPyx suggests the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; rob a couple of items in each and break the safe with sticky bombs. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop — if it does not, hit a 4th.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Hold Up to open the WAiNK app and hold R1 to scan vehicles — scanning is enough, you never need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops on the way there.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first (food, drinks, a shower, Adrenaline to extend it), wear body armor, and line up 5 enemies — gang operations are good for this — with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels and rises as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and land headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.target: steal a docked airliner at VCIA
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — the one at terminals E3/E4 is easiest: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge, get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport; the pop is slightly delayed. Planes parked on the airfield do not count.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code on a note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot; the trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Unlock them with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and grab the cash (bring your partner and hand off a bag). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for van tips to find more. There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way. Each vault pays up to $205,000 and triggers a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… counts: tailing the truck to the bank and robbing its vault counts as the truck robbery. Or do it early: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, stick a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it, then escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane — fly over every black-fogged region until the map is clear. PowerPyx links a guide to the best plane for the job.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total; you only need one per gang, but the 100% checklist needs all 39. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.target: Apple Martini at Ocean View Rooftop Bar
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.target: blue Banshee through the showroom window
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City — you need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — then drive it straight through the showroom window. Only this blue Banshee counts; the pop is slightly delayed. PowerPyx notes it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). It pops after you escape the police. You first go here in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can grab what is left, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.target: max strength, Jason and Lucia together
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between characters. Buy a fitness-club membership and always train together (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner) — while one works out, the other trains automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Robberies and enemy encounters all count, so it usually pops naturally; if not, it can be farmed quickly. PowerPyx warns the Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes police far more aggressive, so avoid going that far.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. No guide has pinned down the trigger yet — check back after more players finish the game, and do not waste time guessing at it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.target: the UFO easter egg, Kelly County
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and return. Follow the path into the woods from the car and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it, it drops the woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. No guide has pinned down the trigger yet — check back once more players have tested it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one job, so it comes naturally with the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest and fastest; the game has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, and every purchase counts.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story garages do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone — just buy them through the app. Robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the quickest way to raise the money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage — he only takes cars without trackers at first, and from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Each garage you own adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes), and use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the cost down.
